title: gateway: emit A/B experiment exposure events with sampling + cardinality guardrails
author: Amara Diallo
body: What: Emit experiment exposure events from the API gateway for route-level A/B testing. This PR adds a low-overhead event emission path gated on (a) a resolved experiment assignment and (b) a configurable sampling policy. Events include the required tags needed for downstream aggregation (latency/cost/error dashboards) while enforcing an allowlist to prevent high-cardinality blowups. Why: Console reporting needs a consistent ground-truth exposure stream to attribute latency/cost/error metrics by (experiment_id, variant_id). Emitting at the gateway ensures we capture exposures even when upstream services return early errors/timeouts and keeps the definition of “exposure” aligned with routing decisions. Design notes: (1) Exposure is emitted once per request after assignment resolution and before upstream dispatch. For streaming, we emit on initial connect only; reconnect attempts reuse the same request_id when present and will not re-emit unless the idempotency key is missing. (2) Privacy: no prompt/content, no raw user identifiers; we include tenant_id + project_id (already used for billing/quotas) and a hashed assignment_key when present. No IP, no user agent, no custom headers. (3) Sampling: default sampling is 1.0 for internal/staging and 0.2 for production behind a dynamic config key; can be overridden per tenant for beta partners. Sampling decision is stable per request based on request_id hash to avoid bias across variants. (4) Cardinality guardrails: only a fixed tag set is allowed; any extra tags from assignment context are dropped with a counter metric. Related: ADR-0188 (Exposure logging + privacy), ab-testing-metrics-schema-v1, ENG-2842 (ingestion). Event schema (gateway -> telemetry): { "schema_version": "ab_exposure_v1", "timestamp_ms": <int>, "request_id": "<uuid/opaque>", "tenant_id": "t_…", "project_id": "p_…", "region": "us-east", "route": "/v1/chat/completions", "experiment_id": "exp_…", "variant": "control|treatmentA", "assignment_key_hash": "h_…" (optional), "model": "<resolved model id>", "deployment_mode": "hosted|dedicated" }. Metrics added: gateway.ab_exposure.emitted (counter), gateway.ab_exposure.sampled_out (counter), gateway.ab_exposure.dropped_tags (counter), gateway.ab_exposure.emit_errors (counter). Implementation: Introduces ExperimentExposureEmitter with a fast-path no-op when assignment is absent. Sampling uses xxhash64(request_id || experiment_id) % 10000 to compute a stable decision. Emission is done on the existing async telemetry queue to avoid adding request latency; enqueue failure increments emit_errors and continues request processing. Testing: Unit tests for sampling determinism, allowlisted tags, and idempotency behavior for streaming reconnect. Integration test in gateway test harness verifies event payload matches schema and is emitted on 4xx/5xx as long as assignment is resolved. Load test sanity: +0.12% CPU at 2k RPS in staging with sampling=1.0 (mostly serialization/queue push); expected to be lower in prod with sampling=0.2. Rollout plan: Land behind config flag telemetry.ab_exposure.enabled (default off in prod). Enable in staging immediately after merge. Enable for beta partners (AcmeAI, internal dogfood tenants) at 100% sampling; then ramp prod sampling to 0.2 once ingestion PR (PR #18388) is fully deployed. Follow-ups: (a) finalize tag set with observability-pack dashboards, (b) ensure request_id propagation on streaming reconnect in SDKs/docs, (c) add per-tenant sampling override UI in Console (Phase 2).
commits: gateway/telemetry: add ExperimentExposureEmitter and payload builder
gateway/routing: emit exposure after policy assignment resolution
gateway/streaming: add idempotency guard for reconnect exposure emission
docs(internal): notes on exposure semantics and tag allowlist
review_conversation: Logan Wright (Telemetry/Analytics): Can we make sampling stable per request so we don’t bias one variant if traffic patterns differ? Also please confirm this will emit on errors/timeouts so we can attribute error rates. | Amara Diallo: Yep—sampling is deterministic using hash(request_id, experiment_id). Emission happens after assignment resolution and before upstream dispatch, so 4xx/5xx still generate exposures if assignment exists. Added integration test covering 500 + exposure emitted.

Allison Grant (SRE/Observability): Tag set needs to be tight. Please do not include raw route_id if it can explode; prefer normalized route string and region only. Also add a metric when tags are dropped so we can detect misconfigs. | Amara Diallo: Implemented allowlist: tenant_id, project_id, region, route (normalized path), experiment_id, variant, model, deployment_mode. Anything else dropped and counted via gateway.ab_exposure.dropped_tags.

Caleb Johnson (Tracing/Metrics): Telemetry queue push failures should never fail requests. Please confirm behavior and add a counter for enqueue errors. | Amara Diallo: Confirmed—enqueue failures are swallowed; request continues. Added gateway.ab_exposure.emit_errors counter and log at debug with rate limit.

Jada Williams (A/B framework): For streaming reconnect, we’ve seen duplicate exposures when clients reconnect without reusing request_id. Can we at least avoid double-emitting when request_id is present? | Amara Diallo: Added idempotency guard keyed on request_id within the stream session. If request_id is missing, we can’t de-dupe reliably at gateway; added a doc note and follow-up to DevEx for SDK guidance.

Vikram Singh (Data-plane): Minor: ensure we emit after assignment but before routing fallback transforms model. We want model field to reflect actual routed model. | Amara Diallo: Adjusted hook to run after final route decision (post-compat fallback mapping) so model is the resolved target.
requested_changes: Make sampling deterministic and document the hash inputs
Add allowlisted tag enforcement and dropped tag counter
Ensure emission failures do not affect request success
release_notes: Gateway now emits ab_exposure_v1 telemetry events for route-level experiment exposures (gated by telemetry.ab_exposure.enabled) with stable sampling and a strict tag allowlist to support downstream experiment dashboards.
